Hotel Belleclaire Central Park.description: Hotel Belleclaire Central Park sits on the Upper West Side near Lincoln Center, with Booking.com guests praising compact rooms, included breakfast on many rate cards, and an easy subway link to Central Park and Midtown theaters. The Belleclaire works well as a week-long base when you want a quieter residential block after long museum and show days.
Hotel Belleclaire Central Park.summary: UWS base with breakfast-inclusive rate cards and strong Lincoln Center access.
Hotel Belleclaire Central Park.address: Upper West Side, New York, NY

Hotel Lucerne.description: The Lucerne Hotel at 201 West 79th Street is a landmark pre-war building on the Upper West Side, with Nice Matin restaurant and a well-stocked bar on site. Booking.com reviewers consistently praise comfortable beds, polished front-desk service, and the short walk to the American Museum of Natural History and Central Park West. Lower scores often mention compact bathrooms and occasional street noise on lower Broadway-facing rooms, yet couples and families still choose the Lucerne for full-service dining without leaving the UWS.
Hotel Lucerne.summary: Classic UWS hotel with restaurant and bar; highly rated on Booking.com.

The Wallace Hotel.description: The Wallace Hotel brings a boutique luxury feel to the Upper West Side, with Booking.com guests citing polished service, spacious rooms, and proximity to Central Park and Lincoln Center. The Wallace is the highest-rated UWS option in the shortlist, best for travelers who will pay more for quieter, design-forward rooms after busy days downtown.
The Wallace Hotel.summary: Boutique luxury on the UWS; top Booking.com scores in the set.
The Wallace Hotel.address: Upper West Side, New York, NY

Hotel Beacon.description: Hotel Beacon offers Upper West Side suites with kitchenettes, making it practical for longer stays near Central Park and the 1 train. Booking.com reviewers frequently mention roomy studios, friendly staff, and the ability to cook simple breakfasts before heading to museums or an evening at Lincoln Center.
Hotel Beacon.summary: UWS suite hotel with kitchenettes; excellent for week-long stays.
Hotel Beacon.address: Upper West Side, New York, NY

Arthouse Hotel.description: Arthouse Hotel fills a 1924 Salvation Army landmark at 2178 Broadway and West 77th Street with pop-art murals, the underground Arden cocktail bar, and the Arden & Amsterdam restaurant on the ground floor. Booking.com reviewers often praise the colorful lobby energy and quick B/C subway rides to the American Museum of Natural History, while noting that street-facing rooms can pick up Broadway traffic noise at night.
Arthouse Hotel.summary: Pop-art UWS hotel with Arden bar and Arden & Amsterdam dining.

The Empire Hotel New York.description: The Empire Hotel New York sits at 44 West 63rd Street beside Lincoln Center’s plaza, with the Empire Rooftop bar overlooking Broadway and the 1 train at 66th Street for Midtown hops. Booking.com guests frequently celebrate the walk to David Geffen Hall and Juilliard after evening shows, while criticizing compact room layouts and occasional slow housekeeping on sold-out weekends.
The Empire Hotel New York.summary: Lincoln Center neighbor with Empire Rooftop and 66th St subway access.

Park Central Hotel New York.description: Park Central Hotel New York anchors Seventh Avenue near Central Park South, offering a large Midtown footprint with multiple food options and quick access to the N/Q/R/W lines. Google and OTA reviewers often mention the value-driven rates and busy lobby, so Park Central works best when price and proximity beat room size.
Park Central Hotel New York.summary: Large Midtown tower near Central Park South; often discounted.

New York Marriott Downtown.description: New York Marriott Downtown sits in the Financial District with harbor views available on many floors and a short walk to the Oculus and Staten Island Ferry. Marriott guests highlight modern rooms, a fitness center, and an easy subway ride to Battery Park attractions when you are willing to trade Times Square buzz for downtown calm.
New York Marriott Downtown.summary: FiDi Marriott with harbor views and modern rooms.

The Manhattan at Times Square Hotel.description: The Manhattan at Times Square Hotel places you on West 51st Street amid Broadway theaters and restaurant rows, with compact rooms typical of older Midtown towers. Reviewers on Google and booking sites stress unbeatable foot traffic to shows while warning that hallways and elevators can feel dated during peak tourist weeks.
The Manhattan at Times Square Hotel.summary: Theater District location; expect compact Midtown rooms.
The Manhattan at Times Square Hotel.address: Times Square / Midtown, New York, NY

New York Marriott Marquis.description: New York Marriott Marquis fills a full block of Times Square at 1535 Broadway, with the View revolving restaurant on the upper floors and indoor access to Broadway theaters below. Marriott.com and Booking.com reviewers give high marks for the unbeatable theater-district location, M Club lounge upgrades, and housekeepers who keep the high-rise moving on sold-out weekends. Common complaints cite tight standard rooms, late-night noise from the square, and crowded elevators during conventions—trade-offs many first-time visitors accept to sleep steps from show time.
New York Marriott Marquis.summary: Iconic Times Square Marriott with revolving restaurant.

Hyatt Grand Central New York.description: Hyatt Grand Central New York connects to Grand Central Terminal, giving you Metro-North, subway, and dining options under one roof. Hyatt guests cite efficient business-hotel layouts, eco-certified operations, and quick walks to the Chrysler Building and Midtown east-side offices when you want transit convenience over tourist scenery.
Hyatt Grand Central New York.summary: Grand Central adjacency with eco-certified Hyatt rooms.
Hyatt Grand Central New York.address: Grand Central / Midtown East, New York, NY

Hotel Edison.description: Hotel Edison has anchored 47th Street since the 1930s, offering art-deco details and a classic Times Square address steps from Broadway theaters. Edison guests on Google and hotel sites mention small but clean rooms, a lively bar, and unbeatable walking access to matinees when you accept the bustle outside the lobby doors.
Hotel Edison.summary: Art-deco Times Square classic near Broadway theaters.
Hotel Edison.address: Times Square / Theater District, New York, NY

Sheraton New York Times Square Hotel.description: Sheraton New York Times Square Hotel spans an entire block on Seventh Avenue, delivering a large-room inventory and club lounges for Marriott Bonvoy members. Sheraton reviewers highlight floor-to-ceiling views on upper levels, a big fitness center, and straightforward access to Port Authority and Broadway shows.
Sheraton New York Times Square Hotel.summary: Large Sheraton tower with Bonvoy perks in Times Square.

Motto by Hilton New York City Times Squa.description: Motto by Hilton New York City Times Square packs efficient micro-rooms with clever storage and a social lobby bar aimed at younger travelers. Hilton’s Motto brand reviews mention affordable nightly rates for the neighborhood, walkable Hell’s Kitchen dining, and easy transfers to Lincoln Center on the 1 train.
Motto by Hilton New York City Times Squa.summary: Micro-room Motto by Hilton near Times Square.

Hyatt House New York/Chelsea.description: Hyatt House New York/Chelsea offers residential-style suites with kitchenettes and complimentary breakfast, popular with Booking.com guests who want Chelsea gallery walks and High Line access. Hyatt House reviewers note spacious living areas and a calm block compared with Times Square while staying on the A/C/E lines.
Hyatt House New York/Chelsea.summary: Chelsea Hyatt House suites with breakfast and kitchenettes.

The Manhattan Club.description: The Manhattan Club occupies residential floors at 200 West 56th Street, offering apartment-style suites with kitchenettes, separate living areas, and on-site fitness between Seventh Avenue and Broadway. Booking.com reviewers frequently highlight spacious layouts for week-long stays near Carnegie Hall, Columbus Circle shops, and Central Park South, with housekeeping and front-desk staff credited for handling extended visits. Common gripes focus on busy elevators during peak check-in and a members-club intake process that feels less like a traditional hotel lobby—attributes that appeal to groups who want more room to spread out in Midtown.
The Manhattan Club.summary: Suite-style rooms near Central Park South.
The Manhattan Club.review1: Suite-style rooms with kitchenettes work well for longer Midtown stays near Central Park.
The Manhattan Club.review2: Subway access is easy from Columbus Circle and Times Square.
The Manhattan Club.review3: Compare nightly totals before booking; rates move with demand.
The Manhattan Club.review4: Lobby and elevator can run busy on weekend arrivals; plan extra time.

Library Hotel by Library Hotel Collectio.description: Library Hotel by Library Hotel Collection sits at 299 Madison Avenue beside the New York Public Library, with ten guest floors themed around the Dewey Decimal System and a rooftop writer's den for quiet reading. Booking.com reviewers praise the intimate scale, complimentary wine hour, and Midtown East location a few blocks from Bryant Park and Grand Central Terminal. Critical notes mention narrow elevator waits and premium pricing for the boutique footprint, yet literature lovers and business travelers often book it for curated rooms and a calmer alternative to massive Times Square towers.
Library Hotel by Library Hotel Collectio.summary: Madison Avenue boutique themed by the Dewey Decimal System.

Hilton Club New York.description: Hilton Club New York delivers timeshare-style suites in Midtown with full kitchens and living rooms, suited to families comparing week-long rates on Booking.com. Hilton Club reviewers highlight washer-dryer units in some layouts, strong transit access, and the need to confirm exact tower entrance before arrival.
Hilton Club New York.summary: Midtown Hilton Club suites with full kitchens.

TownePlace Suites by Marriott New York M.description: TownePlace Suites by Marriott New York Manhattan/Chelsea brings extended-stay layouts to Chelsea with kitchenettes, free breakfast, and Booking.com praise for friendly staff. TownePlace guests use the Penn Station and gallery-district location to split time between downtown museums and Midtown meetings without changing hotels.
TownePlace Suites by Marriott New York M.summary: Marriott extended-stay suites in Chelsea with breakfast.

Pod Times Square.description: Pod Times Square offers compact pod rooms and bunk layouts designed for value-focused travelers who still want a Times Square address. Booking.com reviewers mention efficient showers, a rooftop bar, and easy walks to Broadway while warning that square footage is intentionally small compared with traditional hotels.
Pod Times Square.summary: Affordable pod rooms steps from Times Square.
Pod Times Square.address: Hell’s Kitchen / Times Square, New York, NY

Romer Hell’s Kitchen.description: Romer Hell's Kitchen sits at 851 Eighth Avenue near West 52nd Street, with Neighborhood Café for morning coffee and the So & So's piano bar for supper-club dinners after Broadway shows. Booking.com and Google reviewers praise attentive front-desk staff, rain showers, and modern king rooms that feel quieter than giant Times Square towers, while Restaurant Row and the N/Q/R/W subway are a short walk away. Guests who wanted larger work desks or club-lounge perks sometimes mark value down a notch, yet theater fans and couples often pick Romer for a boutique Hell's Kitchen base.
Romer Hell’s Kitchen.summary: Boutique Hell's Kitchen hotel near Restaurant Row.

Night Hotel Broadway.description: Night Hotel Broadway sits on the Upper West Side near the 96th Street subway, offering budget-friendly rooms for travelers who prioritize Lincoln Center access over luxury finishes. Night Hotel Broadway.summary: Budget UWS option near the 96th Street subway.
